note: Carrying now has a real limit: every item has a true weight (plate armor finally weighs more than a rusty sword — the old numbers were rarity odds, not heft), and once you are over capacity you cannot pick up, loot, or buy more until you sell or use something. You still slow down past 80% and drain stamina past 100%, and quest rewards always land even if they push you over — nothing you earned ever vanishes. Your current load shows in the HUD and in the inventory.
